tagline: Crafted Coffee. Curated Dining. Effortless Moments.
welcomeMessage: Welcome to Aurelia Roast. Select your table below to explore our curated menu, track your order live, or summon a host anytime.

items.name: Aurelia Gold Velvet Latte
items.description: Double-origin espresso folded into silky micro-foamed milk with Madagascar vanilla bean.

items.name: Roasted Hazelnut Cortado
items.description: Equal parts ristretto and warm toasted hazelnut milk for a bold, velvety finish.

items.name: Dark Mocha Truffle Cappuccino
items.description: 70% Belgian dark chocolate melted into rich espresso, dusted with raw cacao.

items.name: Single-Origin Pour Over (V60)
items.description: Hand-brewed Chikmagalur estate Arabica with bright citrus and caramel tasting notes.

items.name: Spiced Cinnamon Flat White
items.description: Velvety double-shot espresso infused with Ceylon cinnamon and organic jaggery.

items.name: 18-Hour Bourbon Vanilla Cold Brew
items.description: Slow-steeped cold brew served over crystal ice with a float of vanilla sweet cream.

items.name: Salted Caramel Espresso Frappe
items.description: Blended espresso, house-made sea salt caramel, and whipped mascarpone cream.

items.name: Yuzu Espresso Tonic
items.description: Crisp botanical tonic water layered with Japanese yuzu citrus and a double espresso shot.

items.name: Iced Tiramisu Cloud Latte
items.description: Chilled espresso over milk topped with whipped mascarpone foam and cocoa dust.

items.name: Belgian Chocolate Hazelnut Shake
items.description: Thick roasted Piedmont hazelnut and dark chocolate milkshake with toasted nibs.

items.name: Ceremonial Uji Matcha Latte
items.description: First-harvest Japanese green tea whisked with steamed oat or dairy milk.

items.name: Kashmiri Saffron Kahwa
items.description: Fragrant green tea steeped with Pampore saffron strands, cardamom, and slivered almonds.

items.name: Hibiscus & Blood Orange Iced Tea
items.description: Ruby-red hibiscus flower infusion shaken with fresh blood orange and mint leaves.

items.name: Smoked Earl Grey Lavender Fog
items.description: Bergamot black tea infused with culinary lavender buds and vanilla steamed milk.

items.name: Smashed Hass Avocado & Feta Sourdough
items.description: Charred country sourdough topped with lime-chili avocado, whipped feta, and pomegranate.

items.name: Truffle Mushroom Brioche Toast
items.description: Sauteed wild shiitake and button mushrooms in white truffle cream on toasted brioche.

items.name: Fluffy Ricotta Hotcakes
items.description: Three golden ricotta pancakes with honeycomb butter, caramelized banana, and maple syrup.

items.name: Turkish Cilbir Poached Eggs
items.description: Two soft-poached farm eggs over whipped garlic labneh drizzled with warm Aleppo chili butter.

items.name: Smoked Chicken & Cheddar Omelette
items.description: Three-egg French fold filled with hickory-smoked chicken, aged cheddar, and chives.

items.name: Classic Eggs Benedict with Turkey Ham
items.description: Toasted English muffin, seared turkey ham, poached eggs, and silky saffron hollandaise.

items.name: Pesto Burrata & Heirloom Tomato Panini
items.description: Pressed ciabatta with creamy burrata, basil-pine nut pesto, and sun-dried tomatoes.

items.name: Chargrilled Paneer Tikka Focaccia
items.description: Rosemary focaccia layered with smoky tandoori cottage cheese, mint aioli, and pickled onions.

items.name: Crispy Portobello & Brie Burger
items.description: Panko-crusted portobello mushroom patty, melted French brie, and caramelized onion jam.

items.name: Truffle Smash Chicken Burger
items.description: Double juicy minced chicken smash patties, Gruyere cheese, truffle aioli, and brioche bun.

items.name: Peri-Peri Grilled Chicken Club
items.description: Triple-decker toasted sourdough with flame-grilled chicken breast, fried egg, and garlic mayo.

items.name: Pulled BBQ Lamb Brioche Sub
items.description: 8-hour slow-braised spiced lamb shredded in smoky espresso BBQ glaze with slaw.

items.name: Margherita Verace Wood-Fired Pizza
items.description: 48-hour fermented sourdough crust, San Marzano tomatoes, fior di latte, and fresh basil.

items.name: Wild Mushroom & Truffle Oil Flatbread
items.description: White mozzarella base topped with roasted forest mushrooms, thyme, and black truffle oil.

items.name: Charred Corn, Jalapeno & Goat Cheese Pizza
items.description: Sweet fire-roasted corn, pickled jalapenos, creamy chevre, and hot honey drizzle.

items.name: Smoked Chicken Pepperoni & Chili Honey Pizza
items.description: Crisp smoked chicken pepperoni cups, mozzarella, oregano, and house-infused chili honey.

items.name: Spiced Lamb Keema & Caramelized Onion Pizza
items.description: Aromatic minced lamb, slow-cooked sweet onions, aged provolone, and fresh coriander.

items.name: Truffle Wild Mushroom Tagliatelle
items.description: Fresh ribbon pasta tossed in roasted garlic-parmesan cream and porcini mushroom ragu.

items.name: Burrata & Roasted Cherry Tomato Rigatoni
items.description: Al dente rigatoni in slow-simmered marinara crowned with a whole cold creamy burrata.

items.name: Creamy Cajun Chicken Alfredo Penne
items.description: Pan-seared Cajun chicken strips over penne in aged parmesan and cracked pepper cream.

items.name: Garlic Butter Prawn Aglio e Olio
items.description: Spaghetti tossed with jumbo tiger prawns, golden garlic chips, extra-virgin olive oil, and chili.

items.name: Herb-Crusted Grilled Chicken Steak
items.description: Rosemary-marinated chicken breast with truffle mashed potatoes, grilled asparagus, and jus.

items.name: San Sebastian Burnt Basque Cheesecake
items.description: Caramelized crust with a molten cream-cheese center served with warm Belgian chocolate sauce.

items.name: Aurelia Espresso Tiramisu (Eggless)
items.description: Savoiardi biscuits soaked in signature Aurelia espresso layered with mascarpone mousse.

items.name: Warm Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Fondant
items.description: Molten dark chocolate cake filled with crispy roasted pistachio kunafa cream.

items.name: Classic French Creme Brulee
items.description: Silky vanilla bean egg custard beneath a crisp, torch-caramelized raw sugar crust.
